transport: POST /api/nba/upload: immutable 500000-byte base64 parts, SHA-256 validation, atomic activation and exact server-side readback with a small receipt. Deploy endpoint before using the new collector.
authentication: PLAY_METRIC_SERVICE_TOKEN must equal server COLLECTOR_SECRET; use Authorization: Bearer. Never save credentials in code or logs.
failure_policy: Preserve each previous competition if its source fails. Verify readback after import. Run the Python collector in an external hourly runner; do not call NBA from interactive web requests.
